name: phil/redirects-bundle
description: Redirects managed in an admin for Symfony: exact, prefix and wildcard sources resolved only when nothing else answered, old domains mapped to a new host, loops and chains refused on save, external targets limited to allowed hosts, a log of paths not found with no visitor data, CSV import and export, and redirect providers for other packages

suggest.easycorp/easyadmin-bundle: For the links of the administration in an EasyAdmin back office
suggest.phil/bot-detection-bundle: For the robot verdict that keeps a robot's 404 out of the log
suggest.symfony/cache: For a PSR-6 pool that keeps the table of redirects between requests
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:redirects:import, export, check and purge-404
suggest.symfony/security-core: For the role that guards the administration
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the CSRF token of the administration's forms
suggest.symfony/translation: For the administration in English and French
